name: CDFW Restoration Grant Programs

funder.name: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

summary: California state grants, through a continuous concept-proposal process, for restoration of wetlands, mountain meadows, rivers, streams and habitat, covering planning, implementation and acquisition projects.

status.quote: CDFW accepts concept proposals on an ongoing basis for its Restoration Grant Programs.

$2 million is available for projects that will develop or enhance Mojave Desert tortoise (Gopherus agassizii) recovery. Mojave Desert Tortoise Recovery: Call for Projects & Grant Guidelines (PDF) Apply through WebGrants Application Deadline: Dec. 3, 2026

applicant_types.quote: eligible applicants for funding include: Tribes, nonprofit organizations and public agencies.

geography.quote: to accelerate the pace and scale of restoration throughout the state
